
{{alias}}( a, b )
    Tests whether two 64-bit signed integers are equal.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a: Int64
        First 64-bit signed integer.

    b: Int64
        Second 64-bit signed integer.

    Returns
    -------
    out: boolean
        Result.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = new {{alias:@stdlib/number/int64/ctor}}( 1234 );
    > var b = {{alias:@stdlib/number/int64/ctor}}.of( 0, 1234 );
    > var v = {{alias}}( a, b )
    true

    See Also
    --------
